rules: Each line amount must equal hours (quantity) times unit rate, to the cent.
The sum of all line amounts must equal the invoice total, to the cent.
Each labor line's hourly rate must match the contract rate card for the role: Senior Recruiter $95, Recruiting Coordinator $62, Sourcer $70, Data Analyst $88.
The same employee must not be billed on more than one line for the same week.
Non-labor charges are allowed only if on the contract's allowed list and within cap: background check fee up to $120, job board posting up to $400; any other charge (e.g. a rush fee) is disputed.
Billed hours for each employee and week must not exceed the approved_hours on that employee's timecard for that week.
If all checks pass, approve the invoice; if any check fails, dispute it and ask Halcyon for a credit memo for the difference.
Until resolved: accept only straight-time hours at the rate card rate, up to the approved hours; do not accept overtime premiums above 40 hours.
open_questions: Is overtime above 40 hours in a week billable at 1.5 times the rate card rate? The contract does not say.
Do job board postings need pre-approval from the hiring manager before Halcyon can bill them? To be asked of the controller.
